method: One row per tested hypothesis; statistics and p-values read from the named artifact fields (or computed from them by the formula in `test`). Status uses the p-value as the test was run (alpha 0.05; 0.05-0.10 inconclusive). Benjamini-Hochberg q-values and Holm adjusted p-values are computed across every row with a p-value, on p_two_sided (the directional one-sided p doubled, capped at 1). t_equivalent = normal quantile of p_two_sided; clears_hlz_t3 applies the Harvey-Liu-Zhu (2016) t > 3 hurdle.
